Who is Captain?

Captain was a helicopter pilot who appeared in LEGO Jurassic World: The Secret Exhibit. ) from Isla Sorna to Isla Nublar. While transporting the animals, a storm appeared and the safety harnesses that the caged dinosaurs were being transported in started to break.

While transporting the animals, a storm appeared and the safety harnesses that the caged dinosaurs were being transported in started to break.
